title: Yucatecan Chicken Empanadas
description: A fusion twist on traditional empanadas, filled with juicy chicken and spices from the Yucatan region of Mexico, wrapped in a crispy pastry crust.

ingredients.name: Ground Chicken
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground chicken breast or tenderloins

ingredients.name: Yucatecan Seasonings
ingredients.notes: A blend of achiote, cumin, and oregano

instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground chicken, lard or shortening, onion, cilantro, and Yucatecan seasonings. Mix well.
Roll out empanada dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch. Cut into circles or squares.
Place a tablespoon of the chicken mixture onto one half of each dough circle, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Brush edges with beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Fold dough over filling and press edges to seal. Use a fork to crimp.
Place empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush tops with remaining egg wash and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
